title: Tick-history monitor RPCs
body: IMonitorService gains GetTickHistory, ReadMemoryAtTick (reconstructed) and GetChipStateAtTick, with proto/gRPC messages and mappers. IHostProtocolClient surfaces ReadRegisters/ReadMemory/Disassemble plus the three new calls.

acceptanceCriteria.text: GetTickHistory returns index-ordered ticks; ReadMemoryAtTick at the newest tick equals current memory
